name: Aims Quick Cleanup Tools
author: Aims Infosoft

sections.description:
Aims Quick Cleanup Tools provides a complete set of essential maintenance tools that help clean unused data, repair configuration issues, and optimize your WordPress site performance — all with a single click.

The plugin is lightweight, safe, and beginner-friendly.
All actions run only when manually triggered, giving you full control.

🔧 Available Tools

  • Fix Broken Images – Correct invalid image paths and HTTP/HTTPS conflicts
  • Clean Orphaned Post Meta – Remove leftover meta from deleted posts
  • Fix Duplicate Slugs – Detect and repair duplicate post/page slugs
  • Clean Orphaned Comments – Delete comments linked to removed posts
  • Clean Expired Transients – Remove expired transients
  • Clean Post Revisions – Delete unnecessary post revisions
  • Clean Unused Tags – Remove tags not assigned to any posts
  • Clean Auto-Drafts – Delete leftover auto-draft posts
  • Optimize Database Tables – Improve performance and reduce database size
  • Regenerate .htaccess – Restore default rewrite rules and fix permalink issues
  • Fix File Permissions – Apply recommended WordPress file and folder permissions
  • Clean Spam Comments – Remove spam comments in bulk

Each tool displays a result summary after execution.

License

You are free to modify and redistribute it under the same license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/aims-quick-cleanup-tools/
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Open Tools → Quick Fix Cleanup to access all maintenance tools
sections.faq:
Is this plugin safe to use?

Yes. Every cleanup tool runs only when you click “Run Fix.”
Because some actions permanently delete data, we strongly recommend creating a database backup before running any fixes.

Does anything run automatically?

No.
This plugin does not run any background tasks, cron jobs, or scheduled cleanups.

Where can I find the tools?

You can find all tools under Tools → Quick Fix Cleanup in the WordPress admin dashboard.
